projections.flow_direction_context: eastward fixed90degree true;tested independently of calendar;section order is not a downstream trajectory.
projections.source_time_basis: Retained HYCOM instantaneous March/June/September/December15,2022 00Z;quarterly probes,not seasonal means/annual envelopes/1991-1992moorings,August1993section orJuly2016campaign.
projections.projection_gate: Frozen upper100m integral/core>10cm/s,interior bracketed selected column and resolved primary lower contour;no positive surface/thermal/relative gate. No opposite-context/deep fill.
projections.branch_scope: Partial77.5-80.5E southern India/Sri Lanka zonal reach,four meridional searches2-6N. Both fixed east90/west270degree components tested every snapshot,not calendar-forced phases or observed axes. Exclude Arabian Sea source branches,Laccadive circulation,northward Bay of Bengal continuation,equatorial jets and subsurface counterflows;near-coast opposite flow/eddies can still confound identity. Upper100m classification is not measured thickness/bottom.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep all four fixed-longitude section references in declared increasing-longitude order;that order is not necessarily downstream for either direction. Selected nodes use derived context profile positions;unselected nodes use original native longitude/latitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit depthless placeholder. Frozen shortestWGS84legs/linear interpolation connect adjacent supported nodes within each direction/date only;never skip gaps,extrapolate,borrow opposite/deeper values or substitute sensitivity cutoffs. Connector distance is not measured current length.
